title: Meal packaging suite

location.series: JKR / Burger King identity case study

slide_intent: Coordinate different containers so customers recognize one service experience across separate objects.
strategic_value: Repeated signatures and warm materials can connect Burger King’s bag, cup, fries and burger packaging.
demonstration: A kraft bag, cup, fries carton and wrapped burger form a meal arrangement on an orange ground with a brown tray.
practical_value: Compare signature scale and supporting graphics across a coordinated packaging set.

content_islands.name: Tall containers
content_islands.spec: Arrange the bag, fries and drink toward the rear.

content_islands.name: Tray and wrap
content_islands.spec: Place the wrapped burger on the foreground tray with a patterned liner.

reference_purposes.Application: The logo and supporting graphics appear across a complete meal packaging arrangement.
